GraceTechnology.Framework: citty CLI command framework; Claude Code plugin skills (SKILL.md) distributed through a marketplace manifest and an OpenPackage manifest
GraceTechnology.TestingStack: bun test (module-level suites per CLI area; wave-level bun test across all test files; scripts/validate-marketplace.ts for packaging)
GraceTechnology.Observability: Stdout/stderr contracts and stable exit codes per CLI subcommand; no external telemetry.

OperationalConstraints.Constraint: Prefer existing project libraries and established repository patterns.
No new external runtime dependencies for integrations (for example the Telegram transport uses dependency-injected fetch).
The CLI must execute through the Bun shebang as the published grace binary.
Every change under skills/grace/* is mirrored to plugins/grace/skills/grace/* in the same commit; validate-marketplace enforces the mirror.
